profile.aboutLead: I’m a UC Berkeley computer science graduate based in New York and working at Palantir Technologies.
aboutParagraphs: My experience spans frontend and backend development, mobile apps, data, and leading engineering teams. I enjoy turning ambitious ideas into clear, dependable software that solves meaningful problems.
Away from a screen, you’ll usually find me studying chess positions, playing tennis, or competing on a badminton court.
